defects.claim: Cached panel placement ignores canvasSize changes, leaving panels out of bounds after a canvas-only resize
defects.scenario: Element resize shrinks the canvas without a window resize event; the menu stays open and redraws with the stale rect out of bounds

defects.claim: Dismissal listeners attach to the module window instead of the canvas's window, so dismissal fails for canvases in iframes
defects.scenario: HUD attached from the parent window to a canvas in an iframe; a wheel outside the menu inside the iframe never reaches the parent window, scrolls the canvas, and the menu stays open
defects.cause: global window used instead of canvas's defaultView

defects.claim: Active editor swallows Tab/Shift+Tab as handled, so Tab cannot close the menu while a text row is being edited
defects.scenario: Editing a text row and pressing Tab: nothing happens and focus stays in the edit until Enter or Escape
defects.cause: editor claims keys it does not handle
